scripts.dev:docs: concurrently -n docs,storybook -c blue,magenta "pnpm -F docs start" "pnpm -F @tosui/react storybook"
scripts.build:site: pnpm -F @tosui/react build && pnpm -F @tosui/react storybook:build && pnpm -F docs build && pnpm -F docs copy-storybook
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm f:lib build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm f:lib storybook:build && pnpm f:docs build && pnpm f:docs copy-storybook
